title: Concurrency control in Python vs parallelism

core_questions: What does the GIL protect, and what does it cost?
When do threads, asyncio and processes each help?
charter.done_when: The learner can pick threads, asyncio or processes for a workload and say why.

claims.text: Only one thread executes Python bytecode at a time in a standard CPython build.
PEP 703 makes the GIL optional in CPython builds.
Free-threaded builds run single-threaded code at the same speed as before.

gil.raw: What does the GIL actually prevent, and why can't Python threads run in parallel on multiple cores?
